title: The First Ladybird

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Shh! Look, on that leaf: the first ladybird of spring! She slept all winter, tucked under some bark.

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Would you look closely with this glass, and write in the notebook what you see?

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Move the magnifying glass to look closely.

questions.ask: How many spots does the ladybird have?
How many spots does the ladybird have?
How many legs does the ant have?

feedback.all_good: Look at your notebook! You noticed what most people walk right past.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Off she goes! She's hungry after her long sleep. She'll eat the greenflies off my beans, bless her.

journal_line: I looked closely at the first ladybird of spring with Mr. Finn.
